name: Shcho tse bulo?
source:
Ten-year-old Ellie goes on a camping trip with her friend. What scary creatures are hiding in the forest, and should they be afraid of them?

[Translated from [url=https://uxodl.itch.io/whatwasit]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
十岁的艾莉和她的朋友去露营。 森林里隐藏着什么可怕的生物，他们应该害怕它们吗？

[译自[url=https://uxodl.itch.io/whatwasit]itch.io[/url]]
